name: Embedded data logger
description: MCU with mass storage (SD/eMMC/flash), RTC with backup, sensor or bus inputs and a host interface for retrieval.
electrical_characteristics: SD card SPI/SDIO with 3.3 V and card-detect
RTC with 32.768 kHz crystal and backup cell/supercap
Burst write currents (SD up to 100-200 mA)
current_power_characteristics: 30-100 mA average; SD write peaks 200 mA
critical_electrical_constraints: SD supply decoupled with >= 10 uF at the socket; SDIO lines length-aligned
RTC crystal isolated from digital traces
Backup diode-OR or RTC's own power switch
stackup_recommendations: 2 layers for simple boards; 4 layers (SIG-GND-PWR-SIG) once a radio module, >48 MHz buses or more than ~60 nets are present
Solid ground plane directly under the MCU and every clock or data bus
placement_rules: Decoupling capacitor at every MCU supply pin within 2 mm, smallest value closest to the pin
Crystal and load capacitors within 5 mm of the oscillator pins, no signals routed underneath
Programming/debug header on an accessible edge; reset and boot buttons reachable in the enclosure
Regulator input and output capacitors adjacent to the regulator pins
routing_rules: Route clocks, SPI/QSPI and USB first, then I2C/UART, then GPIO
Keep crystal traces short and surrounded by ground
USB D+/D- as a 90 ohm differential pair when present (see usb_interface overlay)
No analog or crystal nets across plane splits
copper_ground_requirements: Continuous ground plane; stitch top-side ground pours to the plane with vias every ~5 mm near fast signals
Thermal relief on hand-soldered parts only; solid connection on regulator and module ground pads where reflowed
thermal_considerations: Linear regulators: check dissipation (Vin-Vout)*I against package thermal resistance at max ambient
Radio modules and MCUs above 200 mW need copper area under the exposed pad
emi_emc_considerations: Decoupling and short return paths are the EMI strategy; add series termination on long clock lines
Keep switching regulators away from the antenna and the analog front end
protection_requirements: ESD protection on every connector signal that leaves the enclosure (IEC 61000-4-2 level per product spec)
Reverse-polarity or input over-voltage protection on external DC inputs
verification_requirements: ERC: every power pin decoupled, every strap pin defined at reset
Pin map from tools/pins.py, never from memory
DRC with the fabricator rule set; connectivity of every net
manufacturing_constraints: Standard FR-4, 1 oz copper; JLCPCB basic parts preferred for passives
Fiducials and a test-point for each rail when assembled by machine
unsupported_conditions: SD card on long unshielded traces at SDIO speeds
No write-protect/power-fail handling for the file system
